# package sv

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/sv"
```

Package sv implements IEC 61850 Sampled Values (SV) over Ethernet as specified by IEC 61850-9-2 (Ed2.1), IEC 61869-9 and the UCA "9-2LE" implementation guideline: frame codec, publisher with sample-rate pacing, subscriber with stream statistics and supervision, and the binding to SCL SampledValueControl blocks.

#### Wire format {#hdr-Wire_format}

An SV frame is an Ethernet frame with EtherType 0x88BA, optionally 802.1Q tagged, carrying the header APPID / Length / Reserved1 / Reserved2 (the simulation bit is bit 15 of Reserved1) followed by the BER-encoded savPdu:

	savPdu ::= [APPLICATION 0] IMPLICIT SEQUENCE {
	    noASDU   [0] IMPLICIT INTEGER (1..65535),
	    security [1] ANY OPTIONAL,
	    asdu     [2] IMPLICIT SEQUENCE OF ASDU }
	ASDU ::= SEQUENCE {
	    svID       [0] IMPLICIT VisibleString,
	    datSet     [1] IMPLICIT VisibleString OPTIONAL,
	    smpCnt     [2] IMPLICIT OCTET STRING (SIZE(2)),
	    confRev    [3] IMPLICIT OCTET STRING (SIZE(4)),
	    refrTm     [4] IMPLICIT UtcTime OPTIONAL,
	    smpSynch   [5] IMPLICIT OCTET STRING (SIZE(1)),
	    smpRate    [6] IMPLICIT OCTET STRING (SIZE(2)) OPTIONAL,
	    sample     [7] IMPLICIT OCTET STRING,
	    smpMod     [8] IMPLICIT OCTET STRING (SIZE(2)) OPTIONAL,
	    gmIdentity [9] IMPLICIT OCTET STRING (SIZE(8)) OPTIONAL }

The sample is the dataset in the fixed-size binary encoding of IEC 61850-9-2 (see [Kind](#type-kind) and [Layout](#type-layout)); [LESample](#type-lesample) covers the 9-2LE measurement dataset (4 currents and 4 voltages with quality).

#### Transport {#hdr-Transport}

Frames are sent and received through the shared raw Ethernet layer of package l2 ([Open](#func-open), [Hub](#type-hub), l2.Demux to share one socket with GOOSE).

#### Performance {#hdr-Performance}

The publisher paces samples against an absolute schedule (no drift), batches noASDU samples per frame and encodes into a reused buffer. The subscriber decodes into reused storage ([DecodeInto](#func-decodeinto)) and hands each ASDU to a callback without per-frame allocation; see the benchmarks in the package tests.

## Constants

```go
const (
	// LESampleSize is the size of the 9-2LE sample.
	LESampleSize = 64

	// LECurrentScale is the 9-2LE current resolution: 1 mA per count.
	LECurrentScale = 0.001

	// LEVoltageScale is the 9-2LE voltage resolution: 10 mV per count.
	LEVoltageScale = 0.01

	// LESmpRateProtection and LESmpRateMetering are the 9-2LE sample
	// rates in samples per nominal period (noASDU 1 and 8).
	LESmpRateProtection = 80
	LESmpRateMetering   = 256
)
```

9-2LE dataset (UCA implementation guideline): four currents (IA, IB, IC, IN) then four voltages (VA, VB, VC, VN), each an INT32 instMag.i followed by its Quality — 64 octets.

```go
const (
	// EtherType is the Sampled Values EtherType.
	EtherType = l2.EtherTypeSV

	// EtherTypeVLAN is the IEEE 802.1Q tag protocol identifier.
	EtherTypeVLAN = l2.EtherTypeVLAN

	// SimulationBit is the bit in Reserved1 that marks a simulated
	// message (IEC 61850-9-2:2011 5.3.3.4.4 "S" bit).
	SimulationBit uint16 = 0x8000

	// MaxPayload is the maximum Ethernet payload (after the EtherType)
	// produced by the encoder.
	MaxPayload = 1500

	// minFrame is the minimum Ethernet frame length without FCS; the
	// encoder pads shorter frames.

	// APPID + Length + Reserved1 + Reserved2
)
```

Ethernet and SV framing constants (IEC 61850-9-2).

```go
const (
	SmpSynchNone   uint8 = 0
	SmpSynchLocal  uint8 = 1
	SmpSynchGlobal uint8 = 2
)
```

SmpSynch values (IEC 61850-9-2 Ed2.1): 0 not synchronized, 1 local area clock, 2 global area clock; 5-254 identify a local clock by ID.

```go
const DefaultEventQueue = 256
```

DefaultEventQueue is the default event channel capacity.

```go
const DefaultMaxBurst = 16
```

DefaultMaxBurst is the default number of frames a late publisher sends back-to-back to catch up with its schedule before it skips samples.

```go
const DefaultNominalFrequency = 50.0
```

DefaultNominalFrequency is the nominal power system frequency used to convert a SmpPerPeriod sample rate into samples per second.

```go
const DefaultTimeQuality uint8 = 0x2a
```

DefaultTimeQuality is the TimeQuality octet of refrTm when PublisherConfig.TimeQuality is zero: ClockNotSynchronized (0x20) with 10 bits of sub-second accuracy (IEC 61850-8-1 Table 32), as GOOSE's default. The publisher cannot know whether the host clock is synchronised, so it does not claim it. Before v1.18.0 refrTm was sent with the octet 0x00.

```go
const DefaultTimeout = 100 * time.Millisecond
```

DefaultTimeout is the default stream supervision timeout.

```go
const ResyncAfter = 3
```

ResyncAfter is the number of consecutive out-of-order smpCnt values after which a stream resynchronises to the received counter (EventResync) instead of discarding it: a genuinely reordered ASDU is followed by in-sequence ones, a counter that jumped back is not.

```go
var (
	// ErrInvalidFrame indicates an Ethernet frame that cannot carry an
	// SV message: too short or a malformed 802.1Q tag.
	ErrInvalidFrame = errors.New("sv: invalid frame")

	// ErrNotSV indicates a well-formed Ethernet frame whose EtherType is
	// not 0x88BA.
	ErrNotSV = errors.New("sv: not a Sampled Values frame")

	// ErrInvalidLength indicates that the SV header length field is
	// inconsistent with the frame or the encoded APDU.
	ErrInvalidLength = errors.New("sv: invalid length")

	// ErrInvalidPDU indicates a BER structure error inside the savPdu:
	// bad tag, bad length, missing mandatory field, duplicate or
	// out-of-order field, wrong field size, or noASDU not matching the
	// number of ASDUs.
	ErrInvalidPDU = errors.New("sv: invalid PDU")

	// ErrInvalidData indicates a sample that does not match its dataset
	// layout (wrong size or an undecodable member).
	ErrInvalidData = errors.New("sv: invalid sample data")

	// ErrLimitExceeded indicates that a decoder or encoder limit was
	// exceeded (ASDU count, sample size, frame size).
	ErrLimitExceeded = errors.New("sv: limit exceeded")

	// ErrInvalidValue indicates a value that cannot be encoded in a
	// sample (nil, wrong type, out of range).
	ErrInvalidValue = errors.New("sv: invalid value")

	// ErrInvalidConfig indicates an invalid publisher, subscriber or
	// transport configuration ([*ConfigError] unwraps to it).
	ErrInvalidConfig = l2.ErrInvalidConfig

	// ErrClosed indicates an operation on a closed publisher,
	// subscriber or transport.
	ErrClosed = l2.ErrClosed

	// ErrUnsupportedPlatform indicates that no raw Ethernet transport is
	// available on this operating system.
	ErrUnsupportedPlatform = l2.ErrUnsupportedPlatform

	// ErrPermission indicates that opening a raw Ethernet socket was
	// denied.
	ErrPermission = l2.ErrPermission

	// ErrInterfaceNotFound indicates that the named network interface
	// does not exist.
	ErrInterfaceNotFound = l2.ErrInterfaceNotFound

	// ErrSCL indicates that an SV control block could not be built from
	// an SCL document.
	ErrSCL = errors.New("sv: SCL binding error")

	// ErrNotFound indicates that a requested control block or stream
	// does not exist.
	ErrNotFound = errors.New("sv: not found")

	// ErrValidation is the base sentinel for subscriber validation
	// failures. [*ValidationError] unwraps to it and to one of the more
	// specific sentinels below.
	ErrValidation = errors.New("sv: validation failed")

	// ErrConfRevMismatch indicates a received confRev that differs from
	// the expected configuration revision.
	ErrConfRevMismatch = errors.New("sv: confRev mismatch")

	// ErrDatSetMismatch indicates a received datSet reference that
	// differs from the expected one.
	ErrDatSetMismatch = errors.New("sv: datSet mismatch")

	// ErrSmpRateMismatch indicates a received smpRate or smpMod that
	// differs from the expected one.
	ErrSmpRateMismatch = errors.New("sv: smpRate mismatch")

	// ErrSampleSizeMismatch indicates a sample whose length differs from
	// the expected dataset layout.
	ErrSampleSizeMismatch = errors.New("sv: sample size mismatch")
)
```

Use [errors.Is](https://pkg.go.dev/errors#Is) to test against these values. Decoder failures are [\*DecodeError](#type-decodeerror) values that unwrap to one of the decode sentinels. AppendFrame appends the wire encoding of f to dst. It does not allocate when dst has enough capacity.

### func DecodeInto

```go
func DecodeInto(f *Frame, b []byte, lim Limits) error
```

DecodeInto strictly decodes an SV Ethernet frame into f, reusing f's storage: the ASDU slice, the VLAN tag and svID/datSet strings that did not change are reused, and Sample and Security alias b. Steady-state decoding of a stream therefore does not allocate. On error f holds partial results.

DecodeLE decodes a 9-2LE sample without allocating.


DefaultSmpCntWrap returns the smpCnt modulus for a rate in samples per second: the rate when it is a whole number in 1..65536, else 65536.


## Types

### type ASDU

```go
type ASDU struct {
	// SvID is the sampled value identifier (MsvID/UsvID).
	SvID string

	// DatSet is the dataset reference "<LD>/LLN0$<ds>"; empty when
	// absent (optional, OptFlds dataSet).
	DatSet string

	// SmpCnt is the sample counter.
	SmpCnt uint16

	// ConfRev is the configuration revision.
	ConfRev uint32

	// RefrTm is the refresh time (optional, OptFlds refreshTime),
	// valid when HasRefrTm. RefrTmQuality is its TimeQuality octet.
	RefrTm        time.Time
	RefrTmQuality uint8
	HasRefrTm     bool

	// SmpSynch is the synchronization state (see SmpSynchNone et al.).
	SmpSynch uint8

	// SmpRate is the sample rate (optional, OptFlds sampleRate), valid
	// when HasSmpRate; its unit is given by SmpMod.
	SmpRate    uint16
	HasSmpRate bool

	// Sample is the dataset in the 9-2 binary encoding. Frames decoded
	// with [DecodeInto] alias the input buffer.
	Sample []byte

	// SmpMod is the sample mode (optional, Ed2), valid when HasSmpMod.
	SmpMod    SmpMod
	HasSmpMod bool

	// GmIdentity is the grandmaster clock identity (optional, Ed2.1),
	// valid when HasGmIdentity.
	GmIdentity    [8]byte
	HasGmIdentity bool
}
```

ASDU is one sampled value message.

### type ControlBlock

```go
type ControlBlock struct {
	IEDName, APName, LDInst, LNName, Name string

	// SvCBRef is "<IED><LD>/LLN0$MS$<name>".
	SvCBRef string

	// SvID is the smvID attribute (MsvID).
	SvID string

	// DatSet is "<IED><LD>/LLN0$<dataset>".
	DatSet string

	ConfRev uint32
	SmpRate uint16
	SmpMod  SmpMod
	NoASDU  int

	// Opts are the optional ASDU fields (SCL SmvOpts, MSVCB OptFlds).
	Opts OptFlds

	// HasAddress is false when the Communication section has no valid
	// SMV address for the block; Dst/AppID/VLAN are then zero.
	HasAddress bool
	Dst        MAC
	AppID      uint16
	VLAN       *VLAN // nil when the address has no VLAN parameters

	// Members describes the dataset entries in order; Layout is the
	// flattened sample layout of all their leaves.
	Members []Member
	Layout  Layout
}
```

ControlBlock is a multicast Sampled Values control block resolved from SCL: the SampledValueControl, its SMV address (ConnectedAP) and the dataset layout. References use the on-wire form of IEC 61850-9-2, where the MMS domain is the IED name followed by the LD instance.

```go
type Event struct {
```

Event is a supervision event of a stream.

### type EventKind

```go
type EventKind int
```

EventKind classifies a subscription [Event](#type-event).

```go
const (
	// EventStart: the first ASDU of a stream was received.
	EventStart EventKind = iota + 1
	// EventGap: smpCnt skipped samples (Event.Lost of them).
	EventGap
	// EventDuplicate: an smpCnt was received again.
	EventDuplicate
	// EventOutOfOrder: an smpCnt older than the last one arrived.
	EventOutOfOrder
	// EventTimeout: no ASDU within the supervision timeout.
	EventTimeout
	// EventRestored: ASDUs resumed after a timeout.
	EventRestored
	// EventSynch: smpSynch changed (Event.SmpSynch is the new value).
	EventSynch
	// EventConfRev: confRev changed (Event.ConfRev is the new value).
	EventConfRev
	// EventInvalid: an ASDU failed validation (Event.Err).
	EventInvalid
	// EventResync: the stream was resynchronised to the counter of
	// this ASDU, which is delivered. It is reported when smpCnt went
	// back to 0 out of sequence (9-2 Table 14: the counter is set to
	// zero by a synchronising pulse; also a publisher restart) or after
	// [ResyncAfter] consecutive out-of-order counters. The number of
	// lost samples is unknown (Event.Lost is 0).
	EventResync
)
```

Event kinds.

### type Kind

```go
type Kind uint8
```

Kind is the type of one dataset leaf in the IEC 61850-9-2 sample encoding (Ed2 table "Encoding for the basic data types"). Every kind has a fixed size; values are big-endian.

```go
const (
	KindInvalid   Kind = iota
	KindBoolean        // BOOLEAN, 1 octet (0 = false)
	KindInt8           // INT8
	KindInt16          // INT16
	KindInt32          // INT32
	KindInt64          // INT64
	KindUint8          // INT8U
	KindUint16         // INT16U
	KindUint24         // INT24U
	KindUint32         // INT32U
	KindFloat32        // FLOAT32 (IEEE 754 single)
	KindFloat64        // FLOAT64 (IEEE 754 double)
	KindEnum           // ENUMERATED, 32 bits
	KindDbpos          // CODED ENUM (Dbpos), 32 bits holding 0..3
	KindQuality        // Quality, 32-bit bit string (see [Quality])
	KindTimestamp      // TimeStamp, 8-octet UtcTime

)
```

### type Metrics

```go
type Metrics interface {
	// FrameSent is called after a frame of asdus samples was handed to
	// the transport.
	FrameSent(svID string, asdus int)

	// SendError is called when a frame could not be encoded or the
	// transport rejected it.
	SendError(svID string, err error)

	// ASDUReceived is called for every received ASDU that matched a
	// subscription.
	ASDUReceived(svID string)

	// FrameDropped is called for a received frame discarded before
	// reaching a subscription. reason is "decode", "simulation" or
	// "filtered".
	FrameDropped(reason string)

	// Event is called for every subscriber event, including events
	// dropped because the event queue was full (dropped == true).
	Event(svID string, kind EventKind, dropped bool)
}
```

Metrics receives counters from publishers and subscribers. All methods must be safe for concurrent use and return quickly: they are called on the send and receive paths (per frame or per ASDU). Embed [NopMetrics](#type-nopmetrics) to implement only the hooks you need.

### type PDU

```go
type PDU struct {
	// NoASDU is the number of ASDUs. On encode, zero means len(ASDUs);

	// Security is the raw content of the optional [1] security field.
	// It is carried but not interpreted.
	Security []byte

	// ASDUs holds the application service data units, 1..65535.
	ASDUs []ASDU
}
```

PDU is the savPdu (IEC 61850-9-2 clause 8.5).

```go
func DecodePDU(b []byte) (*PDU, error)
```

### type Publisher

```go
type Publisher struct {

	// ns per sample
	// smpCnt modulus, 1..65536
	// samples per frame, 1..65535 (cfg.NoASDU)

	// Scratch storage of the sending goroutine.

}
```

Publisher sends a Sampled Values stream at its configured rate. Create it with [NewPublisher](#func-newpublisher), then call [Publisher.Run](#func-publisher-run). Update, UpdateSample and the Set methods are safe for concurrent use.

#### func NewPublisher

```go
func NewPublisher(t Transport, cfg PublisherConfig) (*Publisher, error)
```

NewPublisher validates cfg and returns a publisher on t.

#### func (Publisher) Close

```go
func (p *Publisher) Close() error
```

Close stops Run. It does not close the transport.

#### func (Publisher) Config

```go
func (p *Publisher) Config() PublisherConfig
```

Config returns the effective configuration.

#### func (Publisher) Run

```go
func (p *Publisher) Run(ctx context.Context) error
```

Run sends the stream until ctx is done (returning nil) or the publisher is closed (returning nil). Transport errors are counted and logged but do not stop Run, except ErrClosed from the transport, which is returned. Run may be called only once at a time.

#### func (Publisher) SetEnabled

```go
func (p *Publisher) SetEnabled(enabled bool)
```

SetEnabled starts (SvEna true) or stops sending. When enabled again the schedule restarts at the current time and smpCnt continues.

#### func (Publisher) SetSimulation

```go
func (p *Publisher) SetSimulation(sim bool)
```

SetSimulation sets the simulation bit from the next frame.

#### func (Publisher) SetSmpSynch

```go
func (p *Publisher) SetSmpSynch(s uint8)
```

SetSmpSynch sets the synchronization state sent from the next frame. A reserved value ([ReservedSmpSynch](#func-reservedsmpsynch)) is ignored and logged: the state is left unchanged.

#### func (Publisher) State

```go
func (p *Publisher) State() PublisherState
```

State returns a snapshot of the publisher.

#### func (Publisher) Update

```go
func (p *Publisher) Update(values []*mms.Value) error
```

Update sets the sample from one MMS value per Layout leaf. The new sample is sent from the next scheduled sample on.

#### func (Publisher) UpdateSample

```go
func (p *Publisher) UpdateSample(sample []byte) error
```

UpdateSample sets the encoded sample. With a Layout, its size must match. The slice is copied.

### type PublisherConfig

```go
type PublisherConfig struct {
	// Dst is the destination address (usually in 01-0C-CD-04-00-00 to
	// 01-0C-CD-04-01-FF). Src defaults to the transport address.
	Dst, Src MAC

	// VLAN, when non-nil, tags frames with 802.1Q.
	VLAN *VLAN

	// AppID is the APPID (SV range 0x4000-0x7FFF recommended).
	AppID uint16

	// Simulation sets the Reserved1 simulation bit.
	Simulation bool

	// SvID is the MsvID/UsvID (required).
	SvID string

	// DatSet is sent in every ASDU when non-empty (OptFlds dataSet).
	DatSet string

	// ConfRev is the configuration revision.
	ConfRev uint32

	// SmpRate and SmpMod define the sample rate (required, SmpRate > 0):
	// samples per nominal period (SmpPerPeriod, with NominalFrequency),
	// samples per second (SmpPerSec) or seconds per sample (SecPerSmp).
	SmpRate uint16
	SmpMod  SmpMod

	// NominalFrequency is the power system frequency in Hz for
	// SmpPerPeriod (default [DefaultNominalFrequency]).
	NominalFrequency float64

	// NoASDU is the number of samples per frame (default 1).
	NoASDU int

	// SmpSynch is the initial synchronization state. The values 3, 4
	// and 255 are reserved (9-2 Table 14) and rejected.
	SmpSynch uint8

	// Optional ASDU fields (the OptFlds of the SVCB): RefrTm sends the
	// sample time as refrTm, SendSmpRate sends smpRate, SendSmpMod sends
	// smpMod, and GmIdentity, when non-nil, is sent as gmIdentity.
	RefrTm      bool
	SendSmpRate bool
	SendSmpMod  bool
	GmIdentity  *[8]byte

	// SmpCntWrap is the smpCnt modulus. Zero means the number of samples
	// per second when that is a whole number of at most 65536 (so that,
	// with AlignSecond, smpCnt 0 falls on the second), else 65536.
	SmpCntWrap int

	// AlignSecond starts the schedule at the next full second (of Now)
	// with smpCnt 0, as synchronized merging units do.
	AlignSecond bool

	// Layout describes the sample for [Publisher.Update]. Optional when
	// samples are given as bytes ([Publisher.UpdateSample], Sample or
	// Source).
	Layout Layout

	// Sample is the initial sample. Nil means a zero sample of
	// Layout.Size() octets.
	Sample []byte

	// Source, when non-nil, produces every sample instead of the last
	// value given to Update: it appends the sample for info to dst and
	// returns it. It runs on the publisher goroutine and must not block.
	Source func(info SampleInfo, dst []byte) []byte

	// Disabled starts the publisher with SvEna false.
	Disabled bool

	// MaxBurst bounds catch-up after a late wake-up (default
	// [DefaultMaxBurst] frames); samples beyond it are skipped.
	MaxBurst int

	// Now is the clock (default time.Now) that paces the samples and,
	// without Clock, stamps refrTm. Tests may substitute it.
	Now func() time.Time

	// TimeQuality is the TimeQuality octet of refrTm without Clock.
	// Zero uses [DefaultTimeQuality] (clock not synchronised).
	TimeQuality uint8

	// Clock, when non-nil, stamps refrTm: it is called once per frame
	// and returns the time of the frame's last sample and its
	// TimeQuality octet; earlier samples of the frame are stamped one
	// sample period apart before it. The sample schedule keeps using
	// Now, so a step of Clock does not change the sample rate. The
	// server's SV engine sets it from ServerOptions.Clock.
	Clock func() (t time.Time, quality uint8)

	// Logger receives diagnostics; nil disables logging.
	Logger *slog.Logger

	// Metrics receives counters; nil disables metrics.
	Metrics Metrics
}
```

PublisherConfig configures a [Publisher](#type-publisher).

### type PublisherState

```go
type PublisherState struct {
	Enabled  bool
	SmpSynch uint8

	// NextSmpCnt is the counter of the next sample.
	NextSmpCnt uint16

	// Samples and Frames count what was sent; Skipped counts samples
	// dropped to catch up after the publisher fell behind; Late counts
	// frames sent after their scheduled time plus one sample period;
	// SendErrors counts frames the transport rejected.
	Samples, Frames, Skipped, Late, SendErrors uint64

	// Rate is the configured rate in samples per second.
	Rate float64
}
```

PublisherState is a snapshot of a publisher.

### type Quality

```go
type Quality uint32
```

Quality is the IEC 61850 quality in the 32-bit SV encoding: bit i of the integer is bit i of the IEC 61850-7-3 quality (validity in bits 0-1: 00 good, 01 invalid, 11 questionable as written bit0 bit1, i.e. the integer values 0, 2 and 3), the detail-quality bits 2-9, source (bit 10), test (bit 11), operatorBlocked (bit 12) and derived (bit 13); bits 14-31 are reserved and zero.

```go
const (
	QualityGood            Quality = 0
	QualityInvalid         Quality = 1 << 1
	QualityReserved        Quality = 1 << 0
	QualityQuestionable    Quality = QualityInvalid | QualityReserved
	QualityValidityMask    Quality = 0x3
	QualityOverflow        Quality = 1 << 2
	QualityOutOfRange      Quality = 1 << 3
	QualityBadReference    Quality = 1 << 4
	QualityOscillatory     Quality = 1 << 5
	QualityFailure         Quality = 1 << 6
	QualityOldData         Quality = 1 << 7
	QualityInconsistent    Quality = 1 << 8
	QualityInaccurate      Quality = 1 << 9
	QualitySubstituted     Quality = 1 << 10
	QualityTest            Quality = 1 << 11
	QualityOperatorBlocked Quality = 1 << 12
	QualityDerived         Quality = 1 << 13
)
```

Quality bits.

#### func QualityAt

```go
func QualityAt(sample []byte, off int) Quality
```

QualityAt returns the Quality at byte offset off of a sample.

#### func QualityFromValue

```go
func QualityFromValue(v *mms.Value) (Quality, error)
```

QualityFromValue converts an MMS quality BitString (13 or 14 bits) or an integer to a [Quality](#type-quality).

#### func (Quality) IsGood

```go
func (q Quality) IsGood() bool
```

IsGood reports whether the validity is good.

#### func (Quality) Validity

```go
func (q Quality) Validity() Quality
```

Validity returns the validity bits (QualityGood, QualityInvalid, QualityReserved or QualityQuestionable).

#### func (Quality) Value

```go
func (q Quality) Value() *mms.Value
```

Value returns q as the MMS quality BitString of IEC 61850-8-1 (bit 0 first, i.e. in the most significant bit of the first octet): 13 bits, or 14 when the derived bit is set.

```go
	SmpPerPeriod SmpMod = 0
	// SmpPerSec: smpRate is samples per second.
```

### type Stats

```go
type Stats struct {
	Stream StreamKey
	Status Status

	// Frames and ASDUs count what was received; Lost counts samples
	// missing from smpCnt gaps; Duplicates and OutOfOrder count repeated
	// and late counters; Invalid counts ASDUs that failed validation;
	// Timeouts counts timeout transitions; QueueDrops counts samples not
	// delivered because the sample queue was full.
	Frames, ASDUs, Lost, Duplicates, OutOfOrder, Invalid, Timeouts, QueueDrops uint64

	// Resyncs counts [EventResync] resynchronisations of smpCnt.
	Resyncs uint64

	// LastSmpCnt, SmpSynch, ConfRev and Simulation are the values of the
	// last accepted ASDU.
	LastSmpCnt uint16
	SmpSynch   uint8
	ConfRev    uint32
	Simulation bool

	// SmpCntWrap is the smpCnt modulus in use (configured, derived from
	// smpRate or learned).
	SmpCntWrap int

	// Rate is the measured rate in ASDUs per second (over ~0.5 s).
	Rate float64

	// First and Last are the receive times of the first and last ASDU.
	First, Last time.Time
}
```

Stats are the counters of one stream.

### type Subscriber

```go
type Subscriber struct {

	// Receive-goroutine state.

}
```

Subscriber receives SV frames from a transport and dispatches them to subscriptions. Create it with [NewSubscriber](#func-newsubscriber), add subscriptions with [Subscriber.Subscribe](#func-subscriber-subscribe) and call [Subscriber.Run](#func-subscriber-run). Frames may instead be fed with [Subscriber.HandleFrame](#func-subscriber-handleframe) (for example from an l2.Demux port read elsewhere).

#### func NewSubscriber

```go
func NewSubscriber(t Transport, cfg SubscriberConfig) (*Subscriber, error)
```

NewSubscriber returns a subscriber reading from t. t may be nil when frames are fed with HandleFrame only.

#### func (Subscriber) CheckTimeouts

```go
func (s *Subscriber) CheckTimeouts()
```

CheckTimeouts runs one timeout check (Run calls it periodically).

#### func (Subscriber) Close

```go
func (s *Subscriber) Close() error
```

Close stops Run and closes every subscription. It does not close the transport.

#### func (Subscriber) HandleFrame

```go
func (s *Subscriber) HandleFrame(raw []byte)
```

HandleFrame decodes and dispatches one raw Ethernet frame. Frames of other EtherTypes are ignored. It must not be called concurrently with itself or with Run (the decoder reuses its storage).

#### func (Subscriber) Run

```go
func (s *Subscriber) Run(ctx context.Context) error
```

Run receives frames until ctx is done or the subscriber is closed (both return nil), or the transport fails. It also runs timeout supervision.

#### func (Subscriber) Subscribe

```go
func (s *Subscriber) Subscribe(cfg SubscriptionConfig) (*Subscription, error)
```

Subscribe adds a subscription.

### type SubscriberConfig

```go
type SubscriberConfig struct {
	// Limits bounds the decoder (default [DefaultLimits]).
	Limits Limits

	// AcceptSimulation accepts frames with the simulation bit set. By
	// default they are dropped, as by a device not in simulation mode
	// (LPHD.Sim false).
	AcceptSimulation bool

	// SupervisionInterval is how often Run checks stream timeouts
	// (default 10 ms).
	SupervisionInterval time.Duration

	// OnDecodeError, when non-nil, is called for every frame with EtherType
	// 0x88BA that fails to decode.
	OnDecodeError func(raw []byte, err error)

	// Now is the clock (default time.Now).
	Now func() time.Time

	// Logger receives diagnostics; nil disables logging.
	Logger *slog.Logger

	// Metrics receives counters; nil disables metrics.
	Metrics Metrics
}
```

SubscriberConfig configures a [Subscriber](#type-subscriber).

```go
type Subscription struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

#### func (Subscription) Close

```go
func (sub *Subscription) Close() error
```

Close removes the subscription and closes its channels.

#### func (Subscription) Events

```go
func (sub *Subscription) Events() <-chan Event
```

Events returns the supervision event channel. It is closed when the subscription or the subscriber is closed.

#### func (Subscription) Samples

```go
func (sub *Subscription) Samples() <-chan Sample
```

Samples returns the sample channel (nil unless SampleQueue > 0 and OnASDU is nil). It is closed with the subscription.

```go

```

### type SubscriptionConfig

```go
type SubscriptionConfig struct {
	// Dst and Src filter on the Ethernet addresses.
	Dst, Src MAC

	// AppIDs filters on the APPID.
	AppIDs []uint16

	// SvID filters on the svID.
	SvID string

	// Validation: DatSet (when non-empty, checked against ASDUs that
	// carry datSet), ConfRev (when non-zero),
	// SmpRate/SmpMod (when SmpRate is non-zero, checked against ASDUs
	// that carry smpRate) and SampleSize (when non-zero; Layout.Size()
	// when a Layout is given). An ASDU failing validation produces an
	// EventInvalid and is not delivered.
	DatSet     string
	ConfRev    uint32
	SmpRate    uint16
	SmpMod     SmpMod
	SampleSize int
	Layout     Layout

	// NominalFrequency converts a SmpPerPeriod rate (default 50 Hz).
	NominalFrequency float64

	// SmpCntWrap is the expected smpCnt modulus. Zero derives it from
	// SmpRate (or from the smpRate field of the stream); without either
	// the subscriber assumes 65536 and learns the modulus from the first
	// wrap to 0.
	SmpCntWrap int

	// Timeout is the supervision timeout: a stream that sends nothing
	// for this long reports EventTimeout (default [DefaultTimeout]).
	Timeout time.Duration

	// OnASDU, when non-nil, is called synchronously for every accepted
	// ASDU on the receive goroutine. The [Sample] and the slices it
	// references are only valid during the call; copy what you keep.
	// This path does not allocate.
	OnASDU func(s *Sample)

	// SampleQueue, when positive and OnASDU is nil, delivers accepted
	// ASDUs on [Subscription.Samples] as owned copies (allocating per
	// ASDU). When the queue is full, samples are dropped and counted in
	// Stats.QueueDrops.
	SampleQueue int

	// EventQueue is the capacity of the event channel (default
	// [DefaultEventQueue]). Events are dropped when it is full.
	EventQueue int
}
```

SubscriptionConfig selects and supervises one or more SV streams. Zero-valued filters match anything.
